description: Upgrade pubspec.yaml dependencies, Android build configuration, and fix all Dart source code breaking changes so that 'flutter analyze' passes cleanly (no errors). This is the main upgrade feature.
steps: Step 1 - Update pubspec.yaml SDK constraint and dependencies: Change environment sdk to '>=3.0.0 <4.0.0'. Update dependencies to modern versions: firebase_core: ^3.12.1, firebase_auth: ^5.5.1, firebase_database: ^11.3.1, cloud_firestore: ^5.6.5, google_sign_in: ^6.2.2, google_maps_flutter: ^2.12.1, location: ^5.0.3 (or ^6.0.0 if available), http: ^1.3.0, provider: ^6.1.2, cupertino_icons: ^1.0.8. Remove the version pin on google_sign_in if it has none.

Step 2 - Update Android build configuration: In android/build.gradle: update ext.kotlin_version to '1.9.22', update classpath com.android.tools.build:gradle to '8.1.0', update classpath com.google.gms:google-services to '4.4.0'. In android/app/build.gradle: update compileSdkVersion to 34, targetSdkVersion to 34, minSdkVersion to 21 (already 21). Replace 'lintOptions' with 'lint'. In android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties: update distributionUrl to gradle-8.3-all.zip. In android/settings.gradle: update to use the new plugin management style that modern Flutter expects. In android/gradle.properties: add 'android.defaults.buildfeatures.buildconfig=true' if needed.

Step 3 - Fix Dart 3 breaking changes across ALL source files. The following specific changes are needed in each file:

--- lib/homepage.dart ---
- Replace all 'new List<OldUser>()' with '<OldUser>[]' (lines with membersToShow, groupNamesToShow, groupsToShow, membersToShowHomepage, and inside getgroups())
- Replace 'new List<String>()' with '<String>[]'
- Replace 'FlatButton' with 'TextButton' in groupBox widget
- Fix 'Animation animation' to 'Animation<double> animation' in groupBox constructor
- The 'groupBox' class name should ideally be 'GroupBox' but this is a warning not error

--- lib/signinpage.dart ---
- 'GoogleAuthProvider.getCredential' is now 'GoogleAuthProvider.credential' (already correct in code)
- 'AuthResult' is now 'UserCredential' and 'FirebaseUser' is now 'User' (already correct in code)
- '_scaffoldKey.currentState.showSnackBar' needs null safety: use '!' or '?.' operator
- 'autovalidate' parameter on Form is removed, use 'autovalidateMode: AutovalidateMode.disabled' or 'AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction'

--- lib/signuppage.dart ---
- 'autovalidate' parameter on Form -> 'autovalidateMode'
- '_scaffoldKeySecondary.currentState.showSnackBar' needs null safety operator
- 'new List<OldUser>()' -> '<OldUser>[]' if present

--- lib/groupdetails.dart ---
- 'autovalidate: true' on Form -> 'autovalidateMode: AutovalidateMode.always'
- 'new List<OldUser>()' -> '<OldUser>[]'
- 'new List<Widget>()' -> '<Widget>[]'
- 'new List.generate(...)' is fine but check context
- 'Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(...)' is not valid - should be 'Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(...)' - actually the method is 'pushReplacement' which takes a Route, this looks correct

--- lib/groupstatus.dart ---
- 'new List<Location>()' -> '<Location>[]' - BUT there's a name collision: 'Location' from core/Location.dart AND 'Location' from the location package. The import 'package:location/location.dart' brings in a 'Location' class. The local core/Location.dart also defines 'Location'. This needs to be resolved with import aliases or renaming.
- 'location.onLocationChanged()' (with parens) -> 'location.onLocationChanged' (no parens, it's a getter now in location ^5.x)
- 'FlatButton' -> 'TextButton'
- 'new List<Widget>()' -> '<Widget>[]'
- 'new List<String>()' -> '<String>[]'
- 'http.get(String)' -> 'http.get(Uri.parse(String))'
- 'jsonCodec.decode(response1.body)' - response1 from http.get returns Response, .body is String, this should work but verify

--- lib/map.dart ---
- 'http.get(String)' -> 'http.get(Uri.parse(String))' on the line: var response1 = await http.get(...)

--- lib/main.dart ---
- 'accentColor' in ThemeData is deprecated - use 'colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSwatch(primarySwatch: Colors.blueGrey).copyWith(secondary: Colors.blueGrey)' or similar
- MyCustomRoute1 has 'TransitionBuilder' which should be 'buildTransitions' and takes Animation<double> not Animation<Offset>

--- lib/InputTextField.dart ---
- The 'key' field shadows Widget.key. Remove the 'Key key' field and pass key through super constructor instead.

--- lib/model/Group2.dart ---
- Remove unused import of firebase_auth
- 'new List<String>()' -> '<String>[]'
- 'new List<Widget>()' -> '<Widget>[]' in Groups2Manager

--- lib/managers/GroupsManager.dart ---
- 'new List<OldUser>()' -> '<OldUser>[]'

--- lib/managers/Groups2Manager.dart ---
- 'new List<Widget>()' -> '<Widget>[]'

--- lib/helpers/CloudFirebaseHelper.dart ---
- 'collection.doc(item.id).updateData(item.toJson())' is now 'collection.doc(item.id).update(item.toJson())' (already correct in code)
- 'Firestore.instance' is now 'FirebaseFirestore.instance' (already correct in code)

--- test/widget_test.dart ---
- The test is a default counter test that doesn't match this app. Replace it with a minimal test that just verifies the app can be imported, or remove the test body and leave a placeholder.
Step 4 - Run 'flutter pub get' to resolve all dependencies and confirm they resolve correctly.
Step 5 - Run 'flutter analyze' and fix any remaining errors. Iterate until there are zero errors. Warnings and infos are acceptable.
